description: PLANNING RANGES, NOT MARKET RATES. Midpoints of the indicative mid-segment metro ranges in docs/research/04-workflows.md §2.3 (vendor and blog figures that disagree by up to 2×), split into material and labour at the research's labour shares (~30–45%). Most entries are LOW confidence estimates. Rates are ex-GST. Edit every rate you use to your own before sending a quote.
